4.3.1.18 Meta data for application
[SWS_Rte_03620]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00322
⌈The RTE shall forward meta data of a data element to/from COM the application if a
data element
• is used for inter-ECU communication
• and it is referenced by a MetaDataItemSet of its SenderReceiverInter-
face
⌋
Note: If the data element data is buffered by the Rte, then the meta data must be
buffered as well.
The Software Component Template Specification [2] describes the modeling of meta
data in the context of a SenderReceiverInterface. The specification of AUTOSAR COM
[3] describes the extended COM APIs while for Large Data Path in COM the already
existing SduMetaDataPtr struct member of PduInfoType shall be used.
[SWS_Rte_03621]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00322
⌈The RTE shall provide access to single meta data items if a data element is referenced
by a MetaDataItemSet of its SenderReceiverInterface⌋
